entities.summary: Johannes Teyssen is a German economist and lawyer who was the chief executive of E.ON, a German multinational electric utility company, from 2010 to 2021. Since January 2021, he has been a non-executive director of BP plc; since October 2021, a senior advisor at Kohlberg Kravis Roberts; and since 2022, chairman of Swiss energy group Alpiq Holding.
